significance: Described as the only shrine in Kerala with Surya as the presiding deity, standing near Kaduthuruthy in Kottayam district. Its tantric rights are held by descendants of the Nambudiri family of Kapikkadu Marangattu Mana.
story: Legend holds that a Nambudiri who meditated on the sun god was instructed by Surya himself to consecrate the idol on this spot.
